verdicts.reason: A is the original shrunk to 300x250 without any rearranging. Only the headline is legible. The body copy, the 'Reserve a Case' button label, 'Ships late June' and the legal line are too small to read, and the large empty band above the legal line is wasted. B does rearrange the design but breaks the hierarchy. The CTA pill is jammed into the top-left corner over the cut-off dark header band. The oversized Quillbrook logo dominates the canvas. The headline has shrunk to the size of the body copy, and the orange divider crowds it. 'Ships late June' and the legal text compete with the headline. A at least keeps the original's reading order and hierarchy.
